parole.significato: A black person, usually a man.
parole.testo: Probably derived from Northern Ndebele umuntu, with stress on the first syllable, which is uncommon for Nguni languages. From Proto-Bantu *mʊ̀ntʊ̀ (“person”).

parole.significato: A dance from southern Africa, used especially during political protests.
parole.testo: Seemingly from Northern Ndebele [Term?], but the ultimate origin is unclear.
